headline: fshindo returns to ARC-3 gold places

sections.text: fshindo moved from 20th to 19th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board, returning to the gold places at 38.20 with the score unchanged.
The gold line now reaches 19th at 38.20, after sitting at 20th a day earlier. Public standings are provisional.
